verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Stripe exposing an MCP server, CLI, SDKs, and agent plugins so *external* AI agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor, etc.) can act on Stripe's behalf, and it describes AI-driven backend features (Radar fraud scoring, smart retries). But none of the evidence describes a built-in, in-product AI assistant/chat feature embedded in the Stripe Dashboard itself that a user converses with to delegate tasks — the 'analyze with AI' and analytics tooling are also delivered via the external MCP interface rather than a native assistant UI.
